description: Remove vest auto-spawn near prisoner spawn and fix critical item duplication bug in inventory/drop/pickup flow
steps: 1. In PlaytestMode.ts, DELETE the entire 'Spawn armor vest near prisoner spawn' block (lines 1053-1104) that auto-spawns a vest near prisoner spawn. The vest should only appear if manually placed in the map editor via 'item_vest' object type.

2. FIX DUPLICATION BUG - Root cause: In `inventoryDropItem()` method (around line 1421 in PlaytestMode.ts), when a player drops an item from inventory, the code calls `combat.createDroppedItemMesh(dropPos, item.id)` which adds the mesh to `combat.droppedItems`, AND ALSO pushes the same mesh to PlaytestMode's local `this.droppedItems` array. When the player picks it up, `tryPickupItem()` calls `combat.tryPickupItem()` first, which finds and removes the item from `combat.droppedItems` and the scene, returns true, and adds to inventory. But the stale entry in PlaytestMode's `this.droppedItems` array is NEVER removed. Next time the player approaches that position, the stale entry's position still matches, and the item gets added to inventory again (even though the mesh is gone from scene). FIX: In `inventoryDropItem()`, do NOT push to `this.droppedItems`. The item is already tracked in `combat.droppedItems` and will be picked up via `combat.tryPickupItem()`. Remove the line: `this.droppedItems.push({ mesh: lastDropped, itemType: item.id, position: dropPos.clone() });`

3. ADDITIONAL SAFEGUARD for vest duplication - In InventorySystem.ts `addItem()` method: before adding a vest to inventory, check if a vest is already equipped (vestEquipped === true) OR if another vest already exists in a slot. If so, reject the add (return false). This prevents stacking non-stackable items like vests.

4. ADDITIONAL SAFEGUARD in tryPickupItem() in PlaytestMode.ts: After `combat.tryPickupItem()` returns a picked item, verify the picked itemType - if it's 'item_vest' and `this.inventory.getVestEquipped()` is true, do NOT add to inventory (player already has a vest equipped). Return true to consume the pickup but don't duplicate the item.

5. Clean up the stale reference: In PlaytestMode.ts's `tryPickupItem()` method, after a successful `combat.tryPickupItem()`, also search and remove any matching stale entry from `this.droppedItems` that references the same mesh (compare by mesh reference or position proximity). This prevents any leftover ghost entries.
acceptance_criteria: No vest spawns near the prisoner spawn point at playtest start (only editor-placed vests appear)
The duplication path is eliminated: dropping an item from inventory and picking it back up does not create duplicate entries
A player cannot have more than one vest (one equipped + one in inventory simultaneously prevented)
findings: All 5 steps implemented successfully. TypeScript compiles cleanly and Vite build succeeds. The vest auto-spawn block was ~50 lines removed from PlaytestMode. The droppedItems.push line in inventoryDropItem was the root cause of duplication - combat system already tracks items. Added vest dedup check in InventorySystem.addItem and safeguard in tryPickupItem.
